subject: Whether and how to remediate the knowledge BASELINE-000 doctor timeout without weakening its sealed contract

sources.provenance: local Git object read with git show

atomic_claims.claim: Changing the doctor timeout or skipping controller tests would weaken the sealed baseline gate.
Invocation-scoped content-addressed fixture derivation is a bounded test-only candidate worth evaluating.
Shared object stores, alternates, hardlinks, symlinks, persistent caches, cached verdicts, or reused results are safe performance shortcuts.
Production or controller Git caching should be included in this remediation.
A passing or faster candidate may automatically unblock the knowledge program.

verdict.retry_condition: DP-JUDGE-050 issues ADOPT with no material unresolved finding after every sealed qualification gate passes

errata.provenance: Judge comparison of the contract wording with the retained unittest receipt from evidence commit 6bc343f079be6f2d5fd6953d92099a8d5de872b1
errata.corrected_claim: Identical complete unittest ID set digest 7c0cf4ae7a2efca60af613b1702c97133a28b043bad09b231fe3a6c97d23eef4; on the cited host 381 total executions = 380 pass, the same one conditional skip, zero failures, and zero errors.
errata.scope: factual correction only; no gate, scope, command, timeout, p95, role, or rollback change

required_dag.postcondition: retry knowledge BASELINE-000 only after an ADOPT verdict

dissent: A content-addressed seed can become hidden mutable shared state unless every derivation revalidates identity and receives a separate writable object database.
Cold and warm labels do not prove operating-system cache state; receipts must label them as declared modes and avoid claims beyond the observed command timing.
The retained baseline demonstrates the timeout but does not by itself prove HealingFixture construction is the dominant cause.
rollback: Revert one unsquashed node commit, restore the frozen suite, and retain all evidence as superseded.
appeal_conditions: new evidence disproves fixture construction as a material runtime contributor
the candidate changes any frozen test behavior or isolation property
either runtime misses the 135-second nearest-rank p95 burden
a safer bounded candidate demonstrates superior retained evidence
